writingModel: Are you visiting WKU for the first time? Don't worry — it's easier to find than you think! In this guide, I'll explain three different ways to get to the West Kazakhstan University named after Makhambет Utemisov (WKU) campus from the city centre of Uralsk. Whether you prefer walking, taking the bus, or using a taxi app, I've got you covered.

Option 1: By bus. The most affordable option is bus number 14, which runs every 15 minutes between 7:00 am and 9:00 pm. Catch it at the Central Market bus stop on Dostyq Street. The journey takes approximately 20 minutes. Get off at the WKU Main Campus stop — it's announced electronically on the bus, so you can't miss it. The bus fare is 90 tenge, payable by card or cash.

Option 2: By taxi app. For a faster and more comfortable journey, use Yandex Go or InDrive. Simply open the app, type "WKU, Uralsk" as your destination, and a driver will arrive in 3–5 minutes. The journey takes 10–12 minutes and costs approximately 500–700 tenge depending on the time of day. This is the best option if you are carrying heavy bags or travelling in the evening.

Option 3: On foot from Uralsk City Centre. If you enjoy walking and the weather is good, it takes about 25 minutes on foot. From the central fountain on Abai Avenue, walk straight ahead along the main boulevard for approximately 600 metres. Walk past the City Hall building on your right. Then, turn left at the roundabout by the tall monument. Follow the road for another 300 metres. Cross the road at the zebra crossing. WKU's main gate, with its large blue and gold sign, is directly opposite. You can't miss it!

Important tips for visitors: The main entrance to WKU is on University Street. You will need your ID or passport to enter the campus. Free Wi-Fi is available in all buildings. The student information desk is located in the main hall of Building 1 — staff there speak Kazakh, Russian, and English. If you get lost, don't hesitate to ask any WKU student for help — we are always happy to assist! Welcome to our university. 🎓
